groups.reference_limit: Lexical references are candidate dependencies, not proof of use or absence. Historical relative paths use evidence/README.md mapping. Only review may resolve each reader.
unknowns: Raw independent-review archives are protected even if adjacent display duplicates exist; no source/review/external content assumed recoverable from Git.

reassessment.route: Reassess at trigger after code/policy integration, before completion bookkeeping; unresolved or no usable trigger goes to next human QA. Reaching trigger does not authorize deletion.

required_review.fresh_high: pending; verify original content, identities, consumer resolution and policy reconciliation
required_review.human_merge_approval: not supplied; required if scope becomes a merge
required_review.guarded_executor: unavailable; capture helper allocate/register does not execute retirement

inventory_binding.lookup: files records by exact path; copied identities from shared inventory slice, not regenerated

groups.evidence_type: retained source/check results, implementation rationale, metadata and historical authored helpers
supporting_facts: This residual is explicit inventoried paths, not implicit permission for unnamed files. Completion/source/check results retain substantive outcomes after earlier raw retirement; current assessment does not recreate discarded bytes.

Historical authored helper scripts retain logic and original path assumptions; source/instruction identities may include uncommitted/external content. No helper was replayed. Capture evidence-review.json/allocation provenance is not final approval.
Routine-looking filenames alone do not establish disposability. Existing results/retention locators remain evidence of actual scope and historical losses.
remaining_uses: Retained exact-source outcome and meaningful limitations; routine/helper reuse must be assessed by next evidence-workflow reassessment.
